# Laundry Care Skill

This skill reads care labels, sorts laundry, and treats stains before washing. Give the label symbols or a photo description, the fabric, and the stain, and get a wash plan with temperature, cycle, and drying, plus a stain treatment to try first. It helps protect delicates and flags a setting that could shrink a favorite garment.
